canonical_law: Do not trust manifests/control files as proof of application.
apply_note: Read actual file contents; manifests and control docs are clues only.

canonical_law: No extra versioning remains final canon.
apply_note: Patch/version files are source material until absorbed, then redundant review/patch carriers should be removed or quarantined.

canonical_law: Pip is adult, about 25, not fifteen.
apply_note: Correct teen/15 branches or quarantine them as deprecated.

canonical_law: Book 01 is Choices Make World.
apply_note: The Fifteenth Birthday is a chapter/scene marker, not Book 01 title.

canonical_law: Rolzen is Rolzen, not Rosen, and Rolzen is distinct from Rylos Vayne Johnson.
apply_note: Never merge Rolzen/Rylos functions.

canonical_law: Mack never uses human language.
apply_note: Use root pressure, temperature, 40Hz/42Hz resonance, terrain, rooted motion, geology, and protective pressure.

canonical_law: Daisy May never speaks and is never sacrificed.
apply_note: Her power is wordless animal/family truth.

canonical_law: Majiskii remains wordless animal/family truth.
apply_note: She can carry impossible calm/power without speech.

canonical_law: Xethrolund's magic is glyph-based and compiled, like deterministic code/NSQ instruction.
apply_note: Replace loose spellcasting wording with written glyph/instruction/execution language.

canonical_law: Boojay/Rylos is accountability, not redemption.
apply_note: Love may remain real; accountability is not cancelled.

canonical_law: Rylos/Boojay betrayal timing stays late.
apply_note: No signs of darkness until only a few chapters before the Diamond Break; no early villain flattening.

canonical_law: Glass Forge / Glass Palace starts in Book 05.
apply_note: Do not move this arc to Book 01.

canonical_law: Portal time is exactly 400 years.
apply_note: Rolzen is captured about 50 years before Pip returns from portal/stasis.

canonical_law: Quantum field is learned from Xethrolund in the Silence.
apply_note: Glide is unavailable in Silence and regains meaningful use in Lucent/Ursula surface-state after rewind.

canonical_law: Flux field is learned from Rolzen and is opposite quantum field.
apply_note: Rolzen prison-break/Flux discovery must carry Pip's 'that's what it looks like' response.

canonical_law: After prison-break clearance, Pip first hugs and loves on Daisy May and Majiskii, smiles big, then becomes unusually talkative asking Rolzen how it worked.
apply_note: This immediately follows escape safety, before abstraction.

canonical_law: Rolzen's first line to Majiskii is: 'So you must be Majiskii!'
apply_note: Rolzen blushes from surprise; Pip briefly forgot where he was.

canonical_law: Dogs choose only the correct prison route.
apply_note: Hesitation, exploring, looting, or attempts to save the wrong way cost lives.

canonical_law: Rolzen was a gymnast daredevil performer; his partner wraith-aged; he protected New York by luring zombie Mack away until overwhelmed and taken.
apply_note: Backstory must inform his feral rescue state and protective momentum.

canonical_law: Oregon coast / stones / cave dream / Idaho brochure / Onondaga route is active Book 18 canon.
apply_note: Absorbed from v6 patch into active scene index.

canonical_law: Onondaga geode shell, three-day siege, gemstone emergence, zombie Mack attack, southbound pursuit, and Rylos shadow-glass/lemon-sun sequence are active Book 19 canon.
apply_note: Absorbed from v6 patch into active scene index.

canonical_law: Pip pulls Rylos back from wrongful shadow-threshold draw and the Cockatrice-ripper runs Rylos through in that instant.
apply_note: Payoff must be personal, not generic monster strike.

canonical_law: Blood Cello judgment matrix is active endgame law.
apply_note: No-song, love+support, lonely blackout, mockery corruption, marionette-cello, undead punishment, and false-victory failure remain possible judgment branches.

canonical_law: Blood Cello last sentence has no adjectives: subject, verb, object. The note sustains.
apply_note: Do not embellish the final sentence.

canonical_law: Pip dialogue pressure-state law: short/practical in danger; clipped/quiet when hurt; suddenly specific/talkative in breakthrough moments.
apply_note: Apply across all dialogue revisions.

canonical_law: Every satellite character needs at least one meaningful encounter; active core characters need at least three memorable events per book.
apply_note: Use profile scores and scene function; no random permutation.

canonical_law: If an encounter matches a dark-aligned transient character, it becomes a plot-thread obligation.
apply_note: Do not treat it as disposable background.

canonical_law: Wildlife and desert encounter layers must remain individually usable or flaggable.
apply_note: Do not weld them into an inseparable combined system.

canonical_law: Non-WoWaS inspiration characters belong in hidden noncanonical source-inspiration lattice material.
apply_note: Track what must be reimagined and what system reimagines it; do not import franchise material as canon.

canonical_law: Condense the crate into one canonical system before release.
apply_note: No versions of versions of update patches as final surface.

canonical_law: The genuine factor is whole-crate and content-driven.
apply_note: Do not use one manifest, control file, README, registry, authority label, or compressed word count to estimate final size. Read book carriers, scene headings, scene hubs, active files, generated characters/creatures, patches, diagnostics, lattices, orbit files, ecology files, and all other WoWaS surfaces.

canonical_law: The 33-book spine is the primary canonical order, not necessarily the final physical packaging.
apply_note: If full prose expansion makes a canonical book too large, split it into reader-facing volumes while preserving the canonical order.

canonical_law: 5.585M words is only the low visible-spine floor.
apply_note: Do not present it as the final genuine factor. The full-discovery ceiling under consideration is 94M finished prose words pending full file-by-file readout.

canonical_law: WoWaS is a printed-books plus game/CYOA/MUD canon system.
apply_note: Projection and value must account for printed multi-volume books, video game adaptation, choose-your-own-adventure branch layer, and persistent MUD/text-world implementation from the same canon.

canonical_law: Do not undervalue the canon as unfinished notes.
apply_note: Treat the canon as completed creative/intellectual architecture; remaining work is implementation, condensation, prose expansion, and production packaging.

canonical_law: Game, CYOA, and MUD outputs must not fork canon destructively.
apply_note: Prime canon remains the authority; branches are tracked as playable/adaptive paths, failure variants, or exploratory alternate routes without replacing the main canon.

canonical_law: Deletion only follows absorption.
apply_note: Do not delete a source/update/patch/version file merely because it is redundant-looking; delete or quarantine only after its content is represented in active canonical surfaces or final book carriers.
